title: Asesor schema extensions: sales table, types, and FakeRest generator
description: Extend the existing 'sales' table with the Asesor fields from the Sheet Asesores tab: telefono, calendario, linea_negocio (exclusiva|compartida), activo. Also add manager_id (nullable self-reference to sales.id): advisors are assigned to a manager, and TASK-014 uses this column for the manager team-scope RLS (manager reads leads whose asesor_asignado belongs to their advisors). Update TypeScript types, Supabase schema files, and FakeRest data generator for sales. The asesor_asignado column on contacts (leads) references sales.id. The existing sales<->auth.users trigger is unmodified.
acceptance_criteria: src/components/atomic-crm/types.ts extends the Sale type with telefono (string|null), calendario (string|null), linea_negocio ('exclusiva'|'compartida'|null), activo (boolean|null), manager_id (sales id, nullable)
supabase/schemas/01_tables.sql adds the five new columns to the existing sales table (manager_id as nullable FK to sales.id)
src/components/atomic-crm/providers/fakerest/dataGenerator/sales.ts generates values for the new fields (activo=true for most, linea_negocio distributed)
The extended Sale/Asesor type is exported and usable by RLS and UI tickets

non_functional_requirements.performance: No regression on sales list query
non_functional_requirements.security: activo=false advisors are still auth-enabled; account disabling remains the Supabase mechanism
